subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate site or civil engineer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hi Alycia,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites CVs from people building a career in civil construction and lists graduates among the roles you recruit, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

Your self-delivered road, bridge, earthworks and stormwater drainage work is the kind of site role I am aiming for. My design work so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you consider me for a graduate or site engineering opening, now or later in the year? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am writing to ask whether Delaney Civil Engineering has room for a graduate site or civil engineer. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised role, sent because your careers page lists graduates among the roles you regularly recruit.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

Your self-delivered road construction, bridge, bulk earthworks and stormwater drainage work is where I want to build my career. I live in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney. My design experience is from study rather than a paid Australian role, so I would value the chance to learn from your site teams.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my enquiry.
